messages:
Morgan: Heads-up: prod KMS audit logging missing for 03/15 deploys — I think an RBAC change to the keystore-reader role yesterday might've blocked the scanner. Anyone on call?
security-bot: Alert: KMS Audit stream 'keystore-logs' subscription failed at 2026-03-15T07:12Z (reason: AccessDenied)
Priya: On it. Which keystore are we talking about? aws-kms-us-east-1?
Morgan: Yes. Saw this while triaging a couple SAST PRs that failed with 'unable to retrieve secrets' during premerge scans — linking the two.
Jonas: That sounds like the scan worker lost decrypt perms. Quick check: run `kubectl get rolebinding keystore-reader -n scans -o yaml` — I suspect the subject SA doesn't match the current CI SA name.
Morgan: We rotated the CI service account last night. PR 7452 changed the SA name from `scan-runner` -> `scan-runner-v2` and I don't think the rolebinding was updated.
Emma: If the SA changed, EKS IRSA KMS decrypt will fail -> no decrypt calls reaching KMS from the scanner, so audit stream halts. Priya, can you confirm CloudTrail/KMS logs?
Priya: Checked CloudTrail: Decrypt requests stop at 07:09Z. Last entries show principalArn: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/scan-runner-role/scans-runner then nothing. KMS key logs exist but the audit subscription shows repeated 'AccessDenied' when the subscriber tried to read.
Carlos: I can rebind rolebinding temporarily. Snippet I plan to apply:```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: keystore-reader-temporary
  namespace: scans
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: scans-canary
  namespace: scans
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: keystore-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
Jonas: Before changing, let's follow change control: do a canary bind only to `scans-canary` SA, then watch the audit stream and premerge checks. If it resolves, update the main binding and file a small post-change record.
Morgan: Agreed. Also we should update the premerge policy so scanner infra failures surface as infra alerts (not just PR failure that people ignore). This will reduce noisy false-positive triage.
Emma: :thumbsup: I'll open a short RFC for a 'keystore-access-change' checklist and add it to the oncall runbook (steps: announce, validate SA bindings, smoke decrypt, monitor audit stream).
Priya: Temporary canary bind applied to `scans-canary`. Watching logs... CloudTrail shows Decrypt at 07:22Z and the audit subscription started receiving events again. I re-ran a failing SAST job against a sample PR and decrypt succeeded.
Jonas: Long-term, can we add a CI smoke test that performs a harmless `kms:Decrypt` against an ephemeral test key as part of the premerge/integration smoke? That would catch SA/key mismatches before rotation.
Morgan: Yes. And ensure the audit export is owned by a service account that is excluded from automated rotations, or has an automated update path. Also update the KMS key policy to allow a stable role like `scans-smoke` for the test.
Emma: I'll draft the change and tag @caroline (IAM) for review. Also proposing we add a triage label `sdlc:infra` for PRs blocked by infra (so they're routed to eng-sre/eng-security).
security-bot: Note: Incident created INC-2026-0315-01 for KMS audit outage. Assigned to eng-security; severity: low (no evidence of exfiltration).
Morgan: Closing loop: canary resolved the immediate outage, we're proceeding with the RFC and CI smoke. If this recurs we'll do a brief postmortem. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export style: messages in chronological order, prefixed by sender. No title present per agents.md rules.
